stream_sentences.text: A gradual increase in solar wind parameters is expected on 16 Nov due to an SSBC in advance of a positive polarity CH HSS.
Mostly quiet conditions are expected on 14-15 Nov, with an increase to unsettled to isolated active periods on 16 Nov as the CH HSS moves into a geoeffective position.
